walls.note: Turnhout had NO town wall: an open town grown round the castle of the dukes of Brabant and the church, with gates (barriers) between the houses giving onto the fields (inventory 300598). The ring here is only the edge of the built-up town on the Ferraris map; the 'gates' are the road exits, named by destination, not historical gates.

landmarks.n: Kasteel van de Hertogen van Brabant
landmarks.y1650: Ducal castle (12th c., in stone under Mary of Brabant 1363-99); from 1648 Amalia van Solms was lady of Turnhout and renovated it.
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Turnhout' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/300598)

landmarks.y1650: Parish church on the sand ridge beside the castle, main bell tower.
